title: bidens grandiflora var. diversifolia
intro: Bidens grandiflora var. diversifolia, commonly known as Bidens diversifolia, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is a perennial herb native to Asia, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in Bidens diversifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antipyretic effects.
